name: ambrook
description: Ask about your Ambrook books: profit and loss, balance sheets, unpaid invoices, bills due, and transactions that need a category. Read-only.
suggestedPrompts: Compare my profit and loss for the last two months and explain the three biggest changes.
How much do customers owe me, and which unpaid invoices are due soonest?
Which bills are due in the next 30 days, including anything overdue?
